title: Aloo Paratha
instructions:
1. Prepare the dough by mixing flour, water, and salt.
2. Make the potato stuffing by mashing boiled potatoes and adding spices.
3. Roll out the dough and place the stuffing in the center.
4. Fold and roll into a flatbread.
5. Cook on a hot pan with ghee until golden brown on both sides.
6. Serve hot with yogurt or pickle.

title: Dal Tadka
instructions:
1. Boil lentils with water, turmeric, and salt until soft.
2. In a pan, heat ghee and add mustard seeds, cumin, garlic, and chilies.
3. Pour the tempered spices over the boiled dal.
4. Simmer for a few minutes and serve hot with rice.
